svg.title: ProGen3D documentation concept map
svg.desc: A central ProGen3D learning-path node connects to ten documentation categories. Each category node links to its homepage section and states its page count.

g.aria-label: Start and Build. 1 pages. Project orientation, build instructions, quick starts, and repository entry points.
g.title: Start and Build: 1 pages. Project orientation, build instructions, quick starts, and repository entry points.

g.aria-label: Architecture and Runtime. 6 pages. Editor architecture, runtime ownership, grammar semantics, and system integration.
g.title: Architecture and Runtime: 6 pages. Editor architecture, runtime ownership, grammar semantics, and system integration.

g.aria-label: Geometry and Rendering. 13 pages. Primitives, profiles, mesh conversion, cameras, preview rendering, and material pipelines.
g.title: Geometry and Rendering: 13 pages. Primitives, profiles, mesh conversion, cameras, preview rendering, and material pipelines.

g.aria-label: Buildings and Object Models. 31 pages. Building grammars, spatial object models, furniture, placement, and architectural evidence.
g.title: Buildings and Object Models: 31 pages. Building grammars, spatial object models, furniture, placement, and architectural evidence.

g.aria-label: Vehicles and Automotive Models. 82 pages. Vehicle grammars, mathematical models, primitive coverage, fitting, and release packages.
g.title: Vehicles and Automotive Models: 82 pages. Vehicle grammars, mathematical models, primitive coverage, fitting, and release packages.

g.aria-label: Vegetation Systems. 8 pages. Vegetation grammars, building-integrated plants, rendering, and reconstruction evidence.
g.title: Vegetation Systems: 8 pages. Vegetation grammars, building-integrated plants, rendering, and reconstruction evidence.

g.aria-label: Validation and Evidence. 2 pages. Verification reports, requirement audits, comparison reports, and deterministic evidence.
g.title: Validation and Evidence: 2 pages. Verification reports, requirement audits, comparison reports, and deterministic evidence.

g.aria-label: Plans and Research. 3 pages. Implementation plans, proposals, roadmaps, literature reviews, and unresolved research work.
g.title: Plans and Research: 3 pages. Implementation plans, proposals, roadmaps, literature reviews, and unresolved research work.

g.aria-label: Governance and Agent Work. 2 pages. Repository instructions, governed automation, authority boundaries, and refactor tracking.
g.title: Governance and Agent Work: 2 pages. Repository instructions, governed automation, authority boundaries, and refactor tracking.

g.aria-label: Examples and Reference. 2 pages. Example corpora, source mappings, schemas, limitations, and focused reference material.
g.title: Examples and Reference: 2 pages. Example corpora, source mappings, schemas, limitations, and focused reference material.

g.aria-label: ProGen3D learning paths. 150 source-grounded lessons connected by category and concept.
g.title: ProGen3D learning paths: 150 source-grounded lessons connected by category and concept.
